topic: How to help your teen price their first paid gig
caption:
Most teens underprice themselves and quit before they start.

Help your teen research what others charge locally, then set a rate just below market to win that first paying client.

$15/hr for lawn care or $20 for a pet-sitting visit is a real, achievable starting point.

Give them a head start → hustleup.us

copy.headline: Help Your Teen Price Their First Gig Right
copy.body: Have your teen research 3 local competitors, then price 10-15% lower to land that first client. One paid job builds more confidence than a hundred scrolling sessions.
